incident: The checkout service is experiencing a sudden increase in 5xx errors.
stop_reason: no new evidence for two rounds
title: RCA: Increasing DB_POOL_SIZE in checkout-config from 4 to 30 caused checkout pods to exceed PostgreSQL max connections, resulting in 5xx errors.

root_cause.statement: Increasing DB_POOL_SIZE in checkout-config from 4 to 30 caused checkout pods to exceed PostgreSQL max connections, resulting in 5xx errors.

confidence.label: inconclusive
confidence.explanation: Inconclusive: no hypothesis is supported well enough to be called the root cause.

facts.statement: The ShopEdgeHigh5xxRate alert triggered with 67.45% of edge requests failing with 5xx status codes.
The checkout-config ConfigMap was modified to increase DB_POOL_SIZE from 4 to 30.
Checkout deployment was updated and rolled out revision 3 on ReplicaSet checkout-658f4596f5 immediately following the config change.
All three checkout pods of revision 3 are running, passing readiness checks, and have zero restarts.

facts.quote: Readiness probe failed: Get \"http://10.244.1.56:8080/readyz\": dial tcp 10.244.1.56:8080: connect: connection refused
facts.statement: Checkout revision 3 pods experienced transient readiness probe connection refused errors during pod startup until 09:41:29Z.

hypotheses.statement: Increasing DB_POOL_SIZE in checkout-config from 4 to 30 caused checkout pods to exceed PostgreSQL max connections, resulting in 5xx errors.
hypotheses.mechanism: The checkout-config update increased DB_POOL_SIZE to 30 across 3 checkout replicas (up to 90 connections), overwhelming PostgreSQL connection limits and causing database connection failures during checkout requests.

hypotheses.statement: Pod network or CNI routing failure on the worker node hosting 10.244.1.0/24 causes connectivity and probe dial failures across services.
hypotheses.mechanism: A network partition, iptables/kube-proxy corruption, or CNI failure on the node hosting pod CIDR 10.244.1.x prevents TCP connections to container ports, failing readiness probes for edge, inventory, recommendations, and checkout, leading to 5xx errors at the edge.

hypotheses.statement: PostgreSQL instance failure or connection saturation caused backend services to fail health probes and incoming requests.
hypotheses.mechanism: PostgreSQL crashed, became unresponsive, or rejected connections following restarts and pool size adjustments, causing dependent services like checkout to fail /readyz probes and request handling.

hypotheses.statement: Checkout application pods are failing to start or crashing following the rollout at 09:41:19.
hypotheses.mechanism: The newly rolled out checkout pods encounter an initialization error or crash loop when parsing configuration or starting the server, leaving 0 ready endpoints to serve edge traffic.
